axel.title: Axel — design, code & growth
axel.summary: I turn product ideas into production PRs at Axel, connecting design and engineering in both directions. The same hands-on approach extends into brand and growth, with AI coding tools accelerating iteration.

nutra.title: Nutra — fintech for everyone
nutra.summary: A budgeting app for the rest of us. Gamified, friendly, built for people who want to save but can't sustain it. 85% of testers reported higher motivation; 90% loved the play of it.

tiktok.title: TikTok Pay KYC, scaled across markets
tiktok.summary: KYC across Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, and the US for TikTok Pay, Shop, and Live. Vietnam new-user completion 70% → 90%. Vendor docking SOP cut integration cycles by ~40%.

hyundai.title: Hyundai IONIQ 6 — designing for trust at L2+
hyundai.summary: Researching driver confidence during HDA 2.0 handoffs, from real-road and simulator testing to three UI directions. The Green UI recorded a 10% higher confidence score than the original interface in the prototype study.

cone.title: Field of Vision — wearable for visually impaired pedestrians
cone.summary: A wearable + interface system designed for visually impaired pedestrians. Winner of both iF Design Award and Red Dot Design Award in 2025.

TechStack.intro: I design, build, and ship — production PRs at Axel and live products of my own. <ink>Cursor</ink> and <ink>Claude Code</ink> accelerate the work, with MCPs connecting Figma, Unity, and Customer.io to the same workflow.
TechStack.spectrumNote: I move between design and implementation: shape the experience, build it, test it, and bring what I learn back into the design.

SideProjects.intro: Things I build outside Axel — usually to scratch a personal itch, sometimes to test a tool I'm thinking about adopting at work.

Moat.intro: I'm waiting for you to discover my potential.I'm only 23.

About.bio1: I'm a dual-degree student at <ink>Georgia Tech</ink> — BS Industrial Design (2021–2024) and BS Psychology (2023–2026). Design and psychology stuck together because the questions overlap: small frictions, hidden expectations, the gap between what someone says and what they do.
About.bio2: I've designed multi-country KYC for <ink>TikTok Pay</ink>, semi-autonomous HMI for <ink>Hyundai</ink>, a packaging system for the <ink>CDC</ink>, and co-founded <ink>XING Art</ink> with a $300K pre-seed from MiraclePlus and 1K+ real users. Since December 2025, I've been the Founding Design Engineer at <ink>Axel</ink> (Gordian Software, YC W19), reporting directly to the CEO. I own frontend delivery, ship production PRs, and connect design and engineering in both directions. My work also spans brand identity, core ad campaigns, Customer.io emails, and testing, with AI coding tools helping me iterate quickly.
About.bio3: Off the clock — film washing by hand, B&W sketching, cooking for me and my partner, building wireless illuminated dice with roommates. I move fast, hold strong opinions on type and motion, and like the part of design where research, growth, and craft intersect.
About.closingQuote: I'm waiting for you to discover my potential.
